name: No Console Log
description: Warns if edited JavaScript or TypeScript files contain console.log statements
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Warn if edited file contains console.log
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$ ]]; then
  COUNT=$(grep -c 'console\.log' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  if [ "$COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "WARNING: $FILE contains $COUNT console.log statement(s). Consider removing before commit."
  fi
fi
exit 0
